title: State Response Controller

evidence.source_text: State Response Controller is the person appointed by the EMC to exercise control over the response to a major fire.

nodes.text: Ensure safety of responders and community

the consequences of the emergency are managed

evidence.source_text: relief and recovery are integrated with emergency response activities.

nodes.text: Exercise control over the response to a major fire

evidence.source_text: State Response Controller is the person appointed by the EMC to exercise control over the response to a major fire.

nodes.text: May have powers and authority of the Chief Officer of the control agency

evidence.source_text: The State Response Controller, when appointed for a class 1 emergencies has the powers and authority of the Chief Officer of the control agency, provided for under the control agency relevant Act.
